notes: Fictional all: a made-up relation between made-up sets. Transitivity added; direct yes, d1 yes, d2 no (transitivity does not give symmetry). RBox: the instance facts are in the prompt, so each 'Does it follow ...?' query is determinate by construction (no determinacy, no worlds). A 'no' answer (the conclusion does not follow) is the same before and after the insert, since nothing follows about a made-up relation before it, so those queries carry discriminates: false; they are there to keep yes and no balanced (CRITERIA Rule 9) and to catch over-generalization of the inserted property. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
